newsitem.title: USA: L.A. Gear names Trippetti CFO.
newsitem.headline: L.A. Gear names Trippetti CFO.

text.p: L.A. Gear Inc said its president and chief operating officer William Benford will join Shamrock Capital Advisors Inc in early February 1997 and that his duties will be immediately assumed by Bruce MacGregor on an interim basis.

The company also said that Victor Trippetti has been promoted to the position of chief financial officer and senior vice president. Trippetti, who joined the company in 1989, had been vice president and treasurer of the company since July 1992.

MacGregor previously served as vice president, marketing at Avia and was co-founder, president and chief executive officer of Deja Shoe, before joining the company in August, 1996 as senior vice president, product marketing.
